blocks.tamil_translation: who keep the masjids flourishing,” Allah has said. Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا تَوَطَّنَ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلصَّلَاةِ وَالذِّكْرِ، إِلَّا تَبَشْبَشَ اللهُ لَهُ كَمَا يَتَبَشْبَشُ أَهْلُ الْغَائِبِ بِغَائِبِهِمْ إِذَا قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب لزوم المساجد وانتظار الصلوة رقم:٨٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Just as the people of a household rejoice on seeing a relative who had been away in another town for a long time, Allah rejoices on seeing the one who has made the masjid his place of stay for praying and doing Dhikr.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of making the masjid one's place of stay is, in particular, having a connection with the masjid and going to the masjid often.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ يُوَطِّنُ الْمَسَاجِدَ فَشَغَلَهُ أَمْرٌ أَوْ عِلَّةٌ، ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَي مَا كَانَ إِلَّا تَبَشْبَشَ اللهُ إِلَيْهِ كَمَا يَتَبَشْبَشُ أَهْلُ الْغَائِبِ بِغَائِبِهِمْ إِذَا قَدِمَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “A person kept the masjid as his place of stay (he was coming to and going from the masjid frequently). Because of some work or because of illness he became unable to come to the masjid. Then, if he again makes the masjid his place of stay as before, just as the people of his household rejoice on seeing one who has returned from travelling to another town, in the same way Allah too rejoices on seeing him.”
